### `create_doc`

**Create a Doc** · `POST /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/docs` · API v3 · 🟡 write

Create a new Doc.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | number | yes | The ID of the Workspace. |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

<details>
<summary><code>body</code> fields (6)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  | The name of the new Doc. (default `""`) |
| `parent` | object |  | The parent of the new Doc. (default `null`) |
| `parent.id` | string | yes |  |
| `parent.type` | number | yes | The parent Doc type. Use `4` for Space, `5` for Folder, `6` for List, `7` for Everything, and `12` for Workspace. |
| `visibility` | `"PUBLIC"` \| `"PRIVATE"` \| `"PERSONAL"` \| `"HIDDEN"` \| `1` \| `2` \| `3` \| `4` |  | The visibility of the new Doc. For example, `PUBLIC` or `PRIVATE`. |
| `create_page` | boolean |  | Create a new page when creating the Doc. (default `true`) |

</details>

| `name` | string |  | The name of the new page. (default `""`) |
| `sub_title` | string |  | The subtitle of the new page. |
| `content` | string |  | The content of the new page. (default `""`) |
| `content_format` | `"text/md"` \| `"text/plain"` |  | The format the page content is in. For example, `text/md` for markdown or `text/plain` for plain text. (default `"text/md"`) |

### `search_docs`

**Search for Docs** · `GET /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/docs` · API v3 · 🟢 read-only

View the Docs in your Workspace. You can only view information of Docs you can access.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | path | number | yes | The ID of the Workspace. |
| `id` | query | string |  | Filter results to Docs created by the user with the given Doc ID. |
| `creator` | query | number |  | Filter results to Docs created by the user with the given user ID. |
| `deleted` | query | boolean |  | Filter results to return deleted Docs. (default `false`) |
| `archived` | query | boolean |  | Filter results to return archived Docs. (default `false`) |
| `parent_id` | query | string |  | Filter results to children of a parent Doc with the given parent Doc ID. |
| `parent_type` | query | `"4"` \| `"5"` \| `"6"` \| `"7"` \| `"12"` \| `"SPACE"` \| `"FOLDER"` \| `"LIST"` \| `"EVERYTHING"` \| `"WORKSPACE"` |  | Filter results to children of the given parent Doc type. For example, `SPACE`, `FOLDER`, `LIST`, `EVERYTHING`, `WORKSPACE`. |
| `limit` | query | number |  | The maximum number of results to fetch for this page. (default `50`, ≥ 10, ≤ 100) |
| `cursor` | query | string |  | The cursor to use to fetch the next page of results. |
| `next_cursor` | query | string |  | The cursor to use to fetch the next page of results. [deprecated] |
